summary: Still risk-off after hot October CPI and 5% 10-year yields, though the S&P bounced from about -0.9% to about -0.6% by 2:20 ET while Nvidia stays the main drag. Changes: added MSFT put (down ~3% on Anthropic's Claude office tools) and AVGO call (extending Monday's rebound), dropped RKLB and TTWO for lack of momentum and fresh quotes, and trimmed SPY/QQQ/AMD confidence; quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from search snippets.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down about 6% on day two of the Huang probe after Trump said the FBI is looking into it; losing the 166.52 midday low opens the 164.27 52-week low (price estimated).

picks.name: Microsoft
picks.reason: Sudden ~3% drop after Anthropic launched Claude Sheets/Whiteboards/Dashboards aimed at Office; under 525 resumes the slide (price ~527 at 12:45 ET, estimated).

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq still about -1.1% with Nvidia and Microsoft both heavy; rejection under 672.50 and a break of 666.50 retests the lows (price estimated).

picks.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
picks.reason: S&P bounced to about -0.6% but December hike odds near 90% cap rallies; failing at 750 and losing the 745.50 morning-low area resumes the selloff (price estimated from the index).

picks.name: Broadcom
picks.reason: Up about 2% against a red tape, extending Monday's 8.8% rebound on Google TPU and Anthropic tailwinds; over 330 extends, under Monday's 319.48 close fails (price estimated).

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Faded from the 539.25 high to about 512 but still green on the Oppenheimer upgrade and Anthropic deal; reclaiming 520 restarts it, under 505 targets the 500.25 low (price estimated).
